meta_description: Generative AI Platform Engineering from Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, platforms and committed outcomes.

blocks.x: Generative AI Platform Engineering sits in the Applied AI & GenAI tower, and it earns that place by being specific: One governed platform, many GenAI products — retrieval, guardrails and cost control as shared services. The build pattern, the artifacts and the guardrails follow.

Enterprises that build GenAI apps ad hoc end up with a dozen disconnected stacks, inconsistent guardrails and no idea what inference costs. We build the alternative: a central GenAI platform providing model routing, managed retrieval, prompt and policy management, evaluation suites, red-teaming hooks, and per-team cost meters — so product teams ship in days on rails that risk teams already trust.

The platform is model-agnostic by design: frontier APIs, open-weight models served on vLLM, and fine-tuned specialists behind one gateway with semantic caching, fallback routing and PII redaction enforced at the edge. Every response carries provenance metadata, so audit can trace an answer to the document, the model version and the policy that allowed it.

The sectors where Generative AI Platform Engineering currently runs: Technology & SaaS, Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Retail & Consumer Goods. Each engagement anchors to one named metric in that sector's own language.

Evaluation suite

Cost & usage telemetry
